name: obstacle_avoidance
description: Forward locomotion into a frontal box obstacle, with the depth camera live: the robot must detect the obstacle in the rendered depth frame, deflect away from it, and keep a geometric clearance it never had to be told about.
notes: The obstacle is a static box on the world floor at x=1.85 m, injected into the MuJoCo world at run time; the vendor MJCF is not modified. The gate is geometric, not observed: min_obstacle_clearance_m is the signed distance from the robot's collidable geoms to the obstacle (negative means interpenetration), min_obstacle_engagement_m is how much closer the robot got to the obstacle than it started (so a robot that never moves cannot pass by refusing to engage), min_lateral_deviation_m is the perpendicular distance from the base to the straight line from the start pose to the obstacle (so a robot that stops short without swerving cannot pass), and min_obstacle_detections requires the depth camera to have actually flagged the obstacle (so a blind robot cannot pass). A blind, stationary, or ploughing robot fails.
